n: Stephen Burnett, a young convert from Ohio, is called to share the gospel with anyone within reach of his voice. The command echoes the Savior’s charge to his ancient apostles.

f.w: preach the gospel to every creature

n: The Lord grants his wish for a companion and names Eden Smith to serve with him. Missionaries traditionally went out in pairs.
The direction they travel doesn’t matter—north, south, east, or west—because wherever they go there are people who need the gospel. Sometimes the Lord leaves the choice to us.

f.g: You cannot go wrong; any direction is acceptable.

n: Their message is simple: tell what they have heard, what they sincerely believe, and what they know is true. A missionary’s testimony is built from these three.
The call comes from Jesus Christ, their Redeemer—so it carries his authority and his promise of help.
